cost_allocations_invariant_4.name: cost_allocations_invariant_4
cost_allocations_invariant_4.value: trade_leg_id IS NULL OR lot_id IS NULL

ledger_events_execution_effect_kind.name: ledger_events_execution_effect_kind
ledger_events_execution_effect_kind.value: execution_id IS NULL OR kind IN ('execution-principal','manual-settlement','settlement')

postings_invariant_3.name: postings_invariant_3
postings_invariant_3.value: control_key IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(control_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

strategies_archive_check.name: strategies_archive_check
strategies_archive_check.value: ("app"."strategies"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "app"."strategies"."archive_reason" IS NULL) OR ("app"."strategies"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."strategies"."archive_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("app"."strategies"."archive_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

strategy_attachments_timestamps_check.name: strategy_attachments_timestamps_check
strategy_attachments_timestamps_check.value: ("app"."strategy_attachments"."state" = 'pending' AND "app"."strategy_attachments"."ready_at" IS NULL AND "app"."strategy_attachments"."removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("app"."strategy_attachments"."state" = 'ready' AND "app"."strategy_attachments"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."strategy_attachments"."removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("app"."strategy_attachments"."state" = 'removed' AND "app"."strategy_attachments"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
